quality_goals.goalTitle: Reduce Denim Inseam Chainstitch Puckering Defect Rate by 40%
quality_goals.description: Targeted technical reduction of sewing feed-dog puckering and needle cut on heavy twill denim styles through mechanical retrofit and thread tension balancing.

milestones.title: Phase 1: Retrofit differential feed dogs on all 14 double-needle machines
Phase 2: Switch to Groz-Beckert titanium GEBEDUR needles
Phase 3: Maintain <1.2% puckering over 60 consecutive bulk production days

actionPlans.task: Audit silicone needle thread lubricant dispenser daily before morning shift start
Calibrate tension meters on Line 03 machines 10 through 18

quality_goals.goalTitle: 100% On-Time In-House Lab Test Turnaround (<24 Hours)
quality_goals.description: ISO 17025 accredited laboratory commitment to deliver fabric shrinkage, torque, color fastness, and pull-test reports within 24 hours of fabric arrival.

milestones.title: Install automated digital barcode sample intake scanner
Commission second Wascator FOM 71 CLS accelerated washing machine
Sustain <24 hour turnaround for 3 consecutive months

actionPlans.task: Publish weekly lab report turnaround statistics on ERP quality portal

quality_goals.goalTitle: Achieve 98.5% First-Pass Buyer Final Audit Score Across All Brands
quality_goals.description: Ensure pre-shipment inspections conducted by H&M, Zara, Target, and third parties (SGS, Intertek) pass with AQL 1.5/2.5 on first presentation without re-auditing.

milestones.title: Standardize 100% pre-final internal carton audit protocol
Zero AQL critical failures over 100 shipments
Achieve annual factory gold-tier accreditation from H&M and Next

actionPlans.task: Implement digital tablet AQL sampling check at carton sealing stage

quality_goals.goalTitle: Zero Needle Contamination: 100% Lock & Key Policy Compliance
quality_goals.description: Ensure strict 100% compliance with retailer needle and metal safety policies. Every broken needle must be reconstituted on adhesive tape before issuing a replacement.

milestones.title: Replace manual logbooks with digital barcode needle dispensing kiosks
Audit 9-point metal detector calibration logs daily without failure
Maintain 100% annual broken needle tape audit verification

actionPlans.task: Conduct bi-weekly surprise metal detector sensitivity verification using 1.0mm Fe sphere

quality_goals.goalTitle: Reduce Fabric Splicing Loss in Cutting Room Below 1.2%
quality_goals.description: Optimize fabric utilization by introducing laser-guided roll-end splicing and automatic nesting algorithms on automated spreading tables.

milestones.title: Install laser alignment guides on spreader table #3 & #4
Implement roll-end remnant fabric bundling procedure
Reach sustained <1.2% splicing loss for knit single jersey styles

actionPlans.task: Retrain fabric spreading operators on roll-end overlap tolerances (max 2 inches)
